text: WHO consolidated guidelines on tuberculosis: tuberculosis preventive treatment, second edition 244 Overall, MDR TPT was acceptable and held a high social value among participants in the five settings. The most acceptable regimen would have high effectiveness in preventing MDR-TB, mild toxicity, little interference with daily activities, low pill-burden, minimal and convenient clinical follow-ups, and low cost to the participants. Reference 1. WHO operational handbook on tuberculosis. Module 1: prevention – tuberculosis preventive treatment. Geneva: World Health Organization; 2020 (https://www.who.int/publications/i/item/9789240002906).
